tara: Starting this week's release train — tag release-2024.04.2. Canary on api-proxy at 10% now. Release freeze: Fri 18:00 PT -> Mon 06:00 PT. Exceptions -> #release-requests. Full plan: https://go.redwood/releases/2024-04-2 :train:

ops-bot: Observability: brief 8s tail latency at 15:42 UTC in eu-central. Tracing points to queueing on one pod.
devops: Healthcheck: `curl -s https://canary.api.redwood.dev/health` -> "ok", version=release-2024.04.2-canary. Watching CPU on g5 nodes.
release-bot: Canary progress: api-proxy 10% -> 40% (2024-04-05T16:30Z). No error spikes.
product: Reminder to owners: run smoke tests before 50% and confirm here. Link: https://go.redwood/smoke
oncall: Alert cleared in eu-central after pod recycle.
tara: We'll pause at 60% for a 15m watch window. Rollback trigger: >2% error delta for 10m.

tara: Train complete. Reminder: no non-critical merges during freeze. If urgent, follow exception flow. Thanks team :tada:
